sources.entry: Inkstone (砚台) - Open-source Markdown workspace with a wiki built from selected notes and AI answers that cite original passages (source preview for Apple Silicon). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/raistlinsha-plus/inkstone) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Inkstone (砚台) is a local-first Markdown workspace for Apple Silicon Macs that builds a Wiki from selected notes and answers questions with citations that link back to the original passages.
summary.what_it_does: Inkstone lets you copy-import Markdown, TXT, JSON or Mermaid files into a space, then edit the copies and compare them with later changes to the originals. It offers source and rich editing side by side, including tables, JSON trees, diagrams, mindmaps, calendar entries and constrained ECharts charts. Users can ask questions about a single document or in a standalone chat, and follow each citation to the exact original passage. A Wiki can be built from selected documents, with proposed changes shown alongside their cited lines, and verified excerpts can be published when a summary lacks support. Answers can be saved as Markdown. Keyword search runs locally, with optional vector embeddings and optional Cohere-compatible reranking. Documents and Wiki state are stored locally, while questions or relevant material are sent to the configured model service. An optional Brave Search integration can be enabled, and service keys are kept in macOS Keychain.
use_cases: write and edit project notes in Markdown
build a searchable wiki from selected notes
ask questions about my documents and check citations
compare edited notes with original imported files
keep local research notes with AI-cited answers
view JSON, Mermaid diagrams and mindmaps alongside Markdown
how_to_run: git clone --branch v1.0.0-rc.4 <repository URL> (URL truncated in README)
npm ci --registry=<registry URL> (registry value truncated in README)
npm run bundle (builds an ad hoc signed app that runs independently of Node)
notable: Citations open the original source passage, and answers can be checked against multiple cited lines
Wiki builder shows proposed changes and their cited lines, including cases where documents disagree
Optional pixel-art companion characters (Motuan, Yanzhou, Zhiwei) that respond when answers are ready
Local-first storage: documents, indexes, conversations and Wiki state stay on the Mac
Source-and-rich side-by-side editing for Markdown, JSON, diagrams, mindmaps and charts
caveats: Requires macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon; the desktop interface is in Chinese
Building from source needs Apple's command-line developer tools and specific pinned Node, npm and Rust versions
This is a prerelease (RC.4); the README says it still misses supported answers, with 15 of 40 test answers meeting all criteria in a blind AI review
Model, embedding and reranking calls go to configured services that may incur usage charges
